description: Mirabello Immigration answers questions about citizenship, second passports, residency and golden visas, including citizenship and residency by investment, from Mirabello Consultancy's own verified, source-cited data covering 190+ countries. Its origin-aware planner takes the citizenship you already hold plus your goal, and returns ranked routes showing the honest mobility gain over your current passport, indicative cost, timeline and eligibility, each with its source and last-verified date. You can also compare programmes side by side, estimate the total cost for a family, check which programmes are open to your nationality, and request a consultation with a specialist. Information only, not legal, tax, financial or immigration advice; figures are indicative and should be verified against official sources.
